snippet.title: RAVEN-STAR - Run and jump around The Ravine on your journey to find a legendary wishing star!
snippet.description:
Play for free on itch.io https://joseph-supino.itch.io/raven-star?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt A tiny Game Boy Color game about finding a place where you belong.

You are a raven born without wings. Cast out of your village, you must find a way to return home. Run and jump around The Ravine on your journey to find a legendary wishing star.

➡️ More from Joseph Supino https://joseph-supino.itch.io/?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
